maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from fees on new consumer loans originated via AI network and from securitization of newly originated loans, not repairs or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by bank and fintech lending partners and institutional investors in loan ABS; borrowers are private consumers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by adding lending partners and loan volume through its AI network, not through a steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: AI underwriting is API-integrated into partners' origination systems, and funding is committed to them, so switching means re-integration and funding disruption.
